title: spellbookframe
summary: MSUI opens and toggles the spellbook through the bounded host-confirmed adapter, emits the frozen open/close/page-turn cues, and now takes every visible frame, art, grid, rail, page, close, hit, cursor-preview, wrapped-name/rank, type-tab, autocast-corner and tooltip-placement rectangle from SpellbookLaw, PetSpellBookUiLaw or SpellTooltipLaw; the ImGui renderer contains no explicit Vector2 geometry construction. It renders the centered 36x36 Cooldown child, narrow IsCurrentCast ring, all eight skill tabs, exact icon-only 37x37 click ownership, and left/right cast, shift-pickup, raw MacroFrame /cast append, drag-start and receive-drag behavior. The distinct pet-spell list drives the exact bottom Spell/Pet tab pair, class-token title, pet-only 12-slot page, pet cooldown/active state, current-Benilla 71.53-unit autocast brackets and concentric clipped 1,200-star shine, synthesized pet cast, pet pickup cursor and CMSG_PET_SPELL_AUTOCAST with same-frame bar-bit mirroring. The protected rich-tooltip content/right-rank presentation remains unchanged and under adjudication; implemented presentation still carries live verification debt.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification. SetSpellbookOpen now plays igSpellBookOpen/igSpellBookClose on actual open-state transitions and DrawPageButton plays igAbiliityPageTurn on enabled page clicks, through the shared PlayUiSound path with law-owned cue constants.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. Normal P binding and microbutton opens now use the host-confirmed Character/SpellBook replacement pair; close remains surface-owned, and each visible draw derives current tabs, spells, page bounds, title, and buttons from live state.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI's visible immediate-mode draw re-reads current eligible spells, names, ranks, passive state, and icons each frame, covering the XML-visible refresh result without claiming its event engine.
The frozen XML registers cooldown refresh and declares a centered 36x36 Cooldown child, while current DrawSpellButton renders no cooldown child.
Skill-line tabs have a checked ring, but spell buttons do not render the frozen current-cast/current-form checked overlay.

MSUI diverges from Benilla — decide: port Benilla behavior, or record a decision preserving MSUI (only allowed if UI/graphics). Spell buttons and skill-line tabs publish through the shared GameTooltip owner arbitration, but MSUI deliberately retains its existing rich spell tooltip and right-column rank presentation.
Current DrawSpellButton does not reproduce the frozen shift-click pickup/macro-append branch or full receive-drag contract.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI preserves the frozen two-column six-row grid, background/ring/icon layering, normal/pushed/hover art, name/rank anchors, passive ring/name treatment, and exact slot geometry.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI clamps page state per selected skill line, shows the frozen page label and arrow geometry/art, disables boundary arrows, and advances only enabled buttons.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI preserves the frozen right-rail tab background, icon, selected and hover overlays, tooltips, 49-unit stride, and all eight declared tab seats.
The frozen window declares eight skill-line tab seats, while current SpellbookLaw.MaxClassTabs is four and DrawSpellbook truncates the model.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI preserves the 384x512 left-window content, icon and four quadrant layering, title/page typography anchors, exact close-button geometry/art, and close through the native setter.
Cooldown child overlay, checked overlay, shift-click behavior, and tabs 5-8 (blocked on unpromoted dependency packets).

MSUI reused the pet action bar's 58-unit autocast overlay and 30-unit sampled sparkle path in the 37x37 pet spellbook button, while current Benilla uses a 71.53-unit corner overlay and a concentric, button-clipped scale-1.48 shine. The ImGui hit rectangle also extended 145 units across the label instead of remaining on the authored 37x37 CheckButton.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: SpellbookLaw now owns the full frame/host/art/grid/rail/control geometry, exact 37x37 click seat, 71.53-unit overlay and scale-1.48 M2 projection. The renderer emits four 300-particle trails with screen-diagonal star sizing, rotation and a hard button scissor. Focused SpellbookVisual and the full interface clinical suite pass.

openItems.text: The Spellbook renderer still authored cursor-preview, text-line, calibration-window, Spell/Pet tab, autocast-star corner and rich-tooltip frame/anchor/text coordinates directly with Vector2 construction instead of consuming rule-owned geometry.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: Moved the calculations unchanged into SpellbookLaw, PetSpellBookUiLaw and SpellTooltipLaw, added behavioral geometry checks plus a renderer source fence, and preserved the existing rich-tooltip content/right-rank presentation. Focused SpellbookVisual and the full interface clinical suite pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify Shift-P and the bottom tab switch with hunter and warlock pets: Pet/Demon titles, hidden skill-line rail, packet-list ordering, passive presentation, pet-bank cooldowns, active-aura ring/icon, pickup into the pet bar, off-bar casting, right-click autocast, 71.53-unit corner brackets and the clipped concentric shine at multiple UI scales. The focused clinical check covers geometry, projection, population, scissor wiring, add-gate, packet layout and state laws without claiming a live capture.
